paths.description: Homepage and search/filter surface; represents the primary discovery entry point.
All-inventory listing; represents long result pages and card grids.
Representative vehicle detail; covers offer metadata, media and seller contact.
Create-listing journey through vehicle type selection and required-field form.
Unknown URL; covers HTTP/error recovery state.

findings.summary: No dark color scheme
findings.evidence: The dark-emulated screenshot remains the same light gray and white palette as the default capture; computed `color-scheme` is `normal`.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare `color-scheme: light dark` and provide preference-driven surface/text tokens with `prefers-color-scheme` or `light-dark()`.

findings.summary: Route and state changes are abrupt
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found no authored transition behavior and navigation uses ordinary full-page swaps; the page does not use same-document or cross-document View Transitions.
findings.suggestedFix: Add progressive View Transitions to route and major state changes, while retaining normal navigation as fallback.

findings.summary: Page chrome does not respond to scroll state
findings.evidence: The long listing keeps static navigation chrome and DOM/CSS evidence contains no scroll-state container rules or progress affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a sticky header with a CSS scroll-state container query or a lightweight progress/scrollability affordance where useful.

findings.summary: Custom dropdown overlays bypass semantic primitives
findings.evidence: The home DOM contains custom `tz-dropdown` div controls while no `dialog`, `popover`, or `details` elements were found; no anchor-positioning rules were found for floating menus.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native select where possible, or `popover`/dialog with declarative light dismiss and CSS anchor positioning for transient menus.

findings.summary: Advertising chrome competes with listings
findings.evidence: Desktop screenshots devote both side rails and the top banner to advertising around the primary inventory, reducing the visual share given to the core task.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce or defer non-essential ad chrome, reserve stable ad slots, and prioritise inventory in the initial viewport.

findings.summary: Mobile renders a scaled desktop canvas
findings.evidence: At a 360x800 viewport, layout metrics report no viewport meta, a 1010 CSS-pixel layout viewport, and visual scale 0.356; the screenshot shows tiny desktop content rather than mobile reflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a standard viewport meta tag and replace the fixed 1010px shell with fluid/intrinsic responsive layout.

findings.summary: Components do not adapt to their container
findings.evidence: The page probe found zero container rules and the narrow capture preserves the same fixed four-column desktop component layout.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container queries for search controls, cards, and navigation so each component adapts to available inline size.

findings.summary: Touch targets and some focus states are inadequate
findings.evidence: The target probe found 60 controls below 24px in one sampled set, including 17px-high header links and 13px controls; several empty card links focus with `outline: none`.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide at least 24x24 CSS-pixel targets (prefer 44x44 for primary touch controls), non-hover affordances, and clear `:focus-visible` styling.

findings.summary: Loading performance is poor
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 16.0s, FCP 7.7s, Speed Index 16.6s and performance 0.50; the independent trace measured LCP 11.09s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP resource, reduce server/document latency, and defer non-critical scripts, ads, and below-fold work.

findings.summary: The mobile load shifts substantially
findings.evidence: The layout observer measured CLS 0.397 with large shifts of 0.157 and 0.113; 38 of 39 images lacked explicit dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve image/ad space with width, height, or aspect-ratio and use stable font fallbacks.

findings.summary: Main-thread work delays readiness
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports 3.4s of main-thread work, TBT 240ms and time-to-interactive 33.9s; the trace also recorded a 67ms long task.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unnecessary startup work, break long tasks, and schedule non-critical work by priority.

findings.summary: Critical delivery is slow and heavy
findings.evidence: HAR captured 136 requests and 3.53MB transferred; Lighthouse reports 2.51s document response, render-blocking savings of 2.81s, font-display savings of 3s and weak cache lifetimes.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten document latency, defer confirmed non-critical resources, set useful cache lifetimes, use `font-display`, and prioritise the LCP image.

findings.summary: Large unused script and style payloads ship on load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 773KiB of unused JavaScript, 71KiB unused CSS, and 23KiB legacy JavaScript; HAR shows 51 script requests totalling 1.72MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by route/feature, conditionally load analytics and ads, remove unused CSS, and stop serving avoidable legacy code.

findings.summary: Accessible names and labels are incomplete
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails image-alt and link-name; the image probe found 10 images without alt, and the home probe found 20 visible form controls without labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Add meaningful alt text, discernible link names, and programmatic labels for every visible form control.

findings.summary: Text contrast fails WCAG checks
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility reports the color-contrast audit as failing.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust text and essential UI color tokens to meet WCAG AA in default, dark, and forced-color conditions.

findings.summary: Landmarks and focus treatment are incomplete
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports no main landmark; home, listing, create and dealer DOMs contain no `<main>`, and the focus probe found empty card links with no outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Add semantic main/navigation landmarks, remove unnamed links, and make keyboard focus consistently visible in reading order.

findings.summary: The page logs browser errors
findings.evidence: Lighthouse `errors-in-console` audit failed on a clean load.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve network and runtime console errors and monitor uncaught exceptions in production.

findings.summary: Image asset markup is unsound
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 38 of 39 images without dimensions, 26 oversized, 29 without responsive sources, and 30 in legacy formats.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic dimensions, responsive `srcset`/`sizes`, and appropriately compressed modern formats.

findings.summary: DevTools reports platform hygiene issues
findings.evidence: Lighthouse inspector-issues audit failed and also identified legacy JavaScript; the document lacks a standard mobile viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Review DevTools Issues, remove deprecated/legacy behavior, and keep platform metadata and source delivery clean.

findings.summary: Public pages fail mobile-friendly viewport requirements
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails meta-viewport and the DOM/layout probes confirm the primary templates omit viewport metadata, despite crawlable links and permissive robots.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a standard scalable viewport declaration to every public template and preserve real href links.

findings.summary: Sitemap URLs are inconsistent with HTTPS canonicals
findings.evidence: robots points to a sitemap, but the sampled sitemap content lists `http://turbo.az` URLs while page canonicals and transport use HTTPS.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit HTTPS sitemap URLs that agree with canonical links and verify the robots-declared sitemap endpoint.

findings.summary: Vehicle detail pages lack structured product/vehicle data
findings.evidence: The detail page has Open Graph tags but DOM inspection found no JSON-LD block for the visible vehicle, price, availability, and seller data.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org JSON-LD for vehicle/product offers and keep it aligned with visible content.

findings.summary: Security policy and cookies need hardening
findings.evidence: HTTPS, HSTS and nosniff are present, but CSP only declares `frame-ancestors`; Permissions-Policy is missing, and 8 sampled first-party cookies lack Secure while many use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive content CSP, add an intentional Permissions-Policy, and set Secure/SameSite cookie attributes consistently.

findings.summary: Tracking and third-party footprint is excessive
findings.evidence: Tracker capture found 25 third-party origins and seven known tracker domains; HAR recorded 136 requests and cookies include 400-day analytics identifiers.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit vendor necessity, gate optional tracking on consent, shorten identifier lifetimes, batch analytics, and defer third parties until needed.

findings.summary: Authentication exposes no phishing-resistant option
findings.evidence: The visible sign-in entry and rendered/source probes showed no WebAuthn/passkey capability; no permission prompt fired on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey/WebAuthn registration and authentication alongside recovery-safe fallbacks.

findings.summary: The app-like marketplace has no offline worker
findings.evidence: A web-app manifest link is present, but the PWA probe found zero service-worker registrations and the cross-origin manifest fetch failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the manifest fetchable with correct CORS and add a minimal service worker/offline fallback for core browsing and recovery.

findings.summary: Seller form omits useful autocomplete tokens
findings.evidence: The create-listing flow exposes name, email, phone and location fields, but name/email/phone have empty autocomplete values and several controls lack labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply correct `name`, `email`, `tel`, and address autocomplete tokens and preserve visible labels.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes
findings.evidence: The image audit found 26 oversized images, 29 without responsive sources, 30 legacy-format assets and no modern-format images; Lighthouse estimates 1.23MiB image savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants and responsive sources sized to card/detail slots, including decorative ad imagery.
